title: Circuit satisfiability and quadratic systems
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and gates ordered so that each gate uses only input bits or earlier gates. Form a homogeneous quadratic system over the field with two elements, with one coordinate for a constant, each input bit, and each gate output; impose that the constant coordinate is $1$, that every gate coordinate agrees with its gate operation, and that the output coordinate is $1$. Then some input makes $C$ output true if and only if this system has a solution.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits
